worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.summary: Shoot an instant, travel-less psychic glare from your eyes: the psi line leaps between enemies in clear sight, and every target it lands on takes Psychic damage and may be frozen. Each leap needs real line of sight, and a cut line stops the chain; the freeze still obeys Ice typing, freeze-immune abilities and Boss control immunity.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.0: Land an unavoidable hit on a kiting target in the open
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.1: Chain through a packed group and name several targets at once
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.2: Deal Psychic damage to Ice or freeze-immune targets even when the freeze cannot land
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.descript: The first target takes about %1$s Psychic damage; the psi line then leaps to the nearest enemy, hitting up to %2$s enemies in all (the first included), with each further leap multiplying the power by %3$s.
Sight range %1$s, leap distance %2$s; the first strike and every leap need an unobstructed line of sight, and a blocked leap stops the chain at the last real landing point.

Each target has a %1$s chance to be frozen for 8 seconds; while frozen it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks and cannot move, and fire damage thaws it at once. The freeze still obeys Ice typing, freeze-immune abilities and Boss control immunity; no ice shell is shown when the freeze fails.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.unblinki: Unblinking mode now: one more leap, longer range and a higher freeze chance, but a slower windup and cooldown.
Quick-glance mode now: fast and cheap, but it leaps to fewer and closer targets with a slightly lower freeze chance.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.growth.0: From level %1$s the first-target power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.growth.1: From level %1$s first-target power %2$s and leaps %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.preferen: On: +1 leap, range x1.08 and freeze chance x1.2, but +2 windup and +6 cooldown. Off: quick glance, faster and cheaper, but range x0.95 and one fewer leap.
The companion only considers Freezing Glare while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger locks on from further away.
When on, the companion prefers targets with others packed around them (the psi line leaps on); off considers a single target only.
world_combat.move.freezingglare.text.blo: The line of sight was blocked
